|translation='''Title:''' Fall Back!.

'''Card text:'''
If the opponent just initiated a battle at an outdoor location with more than double your total power, use 1 Force to cancel it. Move all your characters there to an adjacent location with no enemy presence.

'''Lore:'''
“K-one zero…all troops disengage.”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face uses 屋外の位置 (outdoor location) and 隣接位置 where the English face says exterior site and adjacent site.
